answer_1.quote: We purposefully avoid confining our study to a specific task to study the nuances of hallucination. Our main contention is that hallucination can occur in any NLG task…
answer_1.outputs: Generated text passages (5,000 per model, total 75,000 sentences)

answer_2.quote: To address this gap, we define Hallucination Vulnerability Index (HVI), a comparative spectrum that allows us to evaluate and rank LLMs based on their hallucination vulnerability…
automatic_metrics: Similarity measure with Google Search API

answer_4.quote: For the annotation task of the 75,000 text snippets, we utilized Amazon Mechanical Turk (Amazon). We obtain sentence‑level annotations for hallucination orientations and categories… This evaluation, carried out by six annotators, aimed to assess whether hallucination was alleviated or not.
answer_4.guideline: Annotators split each paragraph into sentences, then label (i) the hallucination orientation (intrinsic, extrinsic, or none), (ii) the hallucination category (six defined types or miscellaneous), and (iii) the degree of hallucination (mild, moderate, alarming).
